Korrektur: In der TS20Uhr-Sendung vom 17.11.2027 wurde im Rahmen der Berichterstattung zur Deutschen Bank in der Live-Einschätzung der Korrespondentin von "Ermittlungen" gesprochen. Der Begriff "Ermittlungen" ist nicht korrekt. Wir haben die Sendung nachträglich an der entsprechenden Stelle gekürzt.

item.title: [EN|In-Depth] BBC Global News Podcast (Wed 07:26): Nvidia rules out return for disgraced boss
item.description:
Originally published Wed 18 Nov 2026 07:26 IST.

Jensen Huang fails in his bid to be re-hired as CEO of Nvidia after a scandal over his affair with an alleged Chinese spy. The US Securities and Exchange Commission is reportedly investigating whether the company misled investors. Nvidia has meanwhile reported a doubling of revenues during his last quarter in charge.

Also: President Donald Trump is attending a regional economic summit in China, a day ahead of a historic meeting with his Chinese counterpart, Xi Jinping, and the Russian leader, Vladimir Putin, in the city of Shenzhen. The US has lost its measles-free status and infections are continuing to spread. Researchers have been learning more about humpback whales by using drones to collect their snot. We have a report from the West Bank after a 72-year-old Palestinian woman was shot dead by armed settlers in Jericho. New research has found that genes inherited from Neanderthals can reduce the risk of schizophrenia. A Georgia O'Keefe painting that was hidden in a cupboard for years has sold at auction for 4.8 million dollars. And the spacecraft Voyager 1 will clock up a milestone - reaching a distance of one light day from earth.
